intro: A New Threat is an early combat assignment issued by Balir Frosthammer in Coldridge Valley. Dwarven mountaineers have been caught off-guard by a sudden surge of troggs bursting out across Dun Morogh, threatening local settlements and camps.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: I hope you're here to lend us a hand, adventurer. After the last trogg attack, we could use all the help we can get.
I hear the buggers have been popping up all across the lands, and it seems Coldridge Valley is no exception. They've been spotted all over the hills to the southeast and near the frozen lake.
And that's not all, just a few nights ago, they attacked and overran our camp to the west!
We're a bit shorthanded here, friend, and we need strong arms to help drive the troggs back.

clips.title: Completion
paras: If the problems we've had here are indicative of what is happening elsewhere in our lands, by Magni's beard, we have some troubles ahead of us! I can only hope that the king and Senate are taking steps to deal with the threat the troggs pose.

sources.title: Quest text as quoted on the Warcraft Wiki
